title: Sustainability Evidence Export Freshness
dataSources: Sharing activity (`sustain:share`), repairs (`sustain:repair`), compost logs (`sustain:compost`), solar telemetry (`sustain:solar`), sustainability audits (`sustain:audit`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — Olio sharing activity, Repair Cafe repair logs, compost-weight records, and solar-offset telemetry — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and smart-home integrations.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sustain:audit source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures evidence export lag by data source for sustainability evidence feeds.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside sustainability evidence feeds.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `evidence export lag` on `sustain:audit` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst evidence export lag.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how long things take for each data source so you can see where sustainability evidence feeds slows down.
